events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to Grand Haven.** My rating: **3 (good)**.
- **Muskegon: 1 (below average).** Fish from a boat, but expect a slower day.
- **St. Joseph: 2 (average).** Your second choice, and the one to watch if cold water arrives.
- **South Haven: 1 (below average) for salmon.** The recent boat action there was mostly lake trout.
- **At Grand Haven, fish 130-220 ft of water, with lines 65-120 ft down.** Use meat rigs (yellow or green) and green flies. Glow spoons are worth trying in low light.
- These ratings are my forecast from the July 19 reports, which are six days old. They are not a report on this week.

## Why

- **Grand Haven is my pick because its latest boat report was the only "good" rating of the four.** The July 19 Grand Haven report rated boat fishing 3 (good), with meat rigs and green flies working.
- **I'd expect Muskegon to be weaker than Grand Haven because it reported the same week and rated boats 1 (below average).** The July 19 Muskegon report called the action "hit or miss."
- **I'd expect St. Joseph to be average, with a chance of improving.** Its July 19 report rated boats 2, and the buoy and wind data show a recent upwelling signal there.
- **I'd rate South Haven low for salmon because the recent boat report described mostly lake trout.** The July 19 South Haven report rated the boat bite 1 for coho, with lake trout the main catch.

## Evidence

**Recent reports (all from the July 19 bulletin, the newest; about six days old)**
- Grand Haven (2023-07-19): boat anglers caught "a mix of salmon and trout 65 to 120 feet down in 130 to 220 feet of water." Quality 3. Meat rigs and green flies worked. A separate chinook entry said glow spoons worked in low light (not rated).
- Muskegon (2023-07-19): "hit or miss." Best action 60-100 ft down in 110-200 ft of water. Quality 1. Glow spoons and meat rigs.
- St. Joseph (2023-07-19): "catching a few fish in 100 feet of water." Quality 2. The report says fishing was "slowing down."
- South Haven (2023-07-19): "decent fishing," but "mostly lake trout with some coho." Quality 1.

**Past seasons (similar water temperature, history only)**
- Early August 2022 at Grand Haven (2022-08-03): boats rated 2, with fish 65-140 ft down on green flies and meat rigs. Muskegon the same week rated 3, with glow spoons and meat rigs working well.
- Mid-July 2022 (2022-07-14): Grand Haven and Muskegon were both slow (0), with a lot of upwelling wind that week (54-58 hours).
- I'd expect the July 2022 pattern to repeat if strong north or east winds return: those weeks were slow.

**Conditions now (measured buoy temperatures and the NOAA satellite estimate for the week before July 25)**
- Buoy surface water: St. Joseph 73 F (+3 over the week), South Haven 73 F (+1), Grand Haven 71 F (flat), Muskegon 71 F (flat).
- St. Joseph had 12 hours of upwelling-favoring wind in the past week, 7 of them in the last three days. South Haven had 7 hours, 4 in the last three days. Grand Haven and Muskegon had 14 and 11 hours for the week, with none in the last three days.
- Forecast wind for the coming days was not available in this data, so I can't speak to the weekend. Check wind before you go.
- General guidance (NY DEC): Chinook and coho prefer 52-58 F water. At 71-73 F at the surface, I'd expect the fish to be deeper, which fits the 60-120 ft depths the reports describe.

## Caveats

- The newest reports are from July 19, six days before today. Treat the ratings as a guide, not current conditions.
- The buoy temperatures are measured. The cold-layer depth isn't available in this data, so I can't give a modeled depth.
- Grand Haven and Muskegon share a buoy and the same week, yet rated differently (3 vs. 1). A single report can swing the picture, so it's a weak basis for ranking them.
- The wind figures for Grand Haven and Muskegon in the conditions summary differ from the July 19 reports. I used the conditions summary, but the difference shows these numbers are approximate.
- The ratings for South Haven and St. Joseph are based on very few fish, so treat them as low-confidence.

## Sources

- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph, week of July 19, 2023: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/366250d
- St. Joseph and South Haven, week of July 5, 2023: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/363ad03
- Past season comparisons (history only): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3268d0b (Aug 3, 2022), https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/321350c (July 14, 2022)
